headline: How Much Of Apple Stock Rides On One Product?
summary: Investors in Apple (AAPL) know the iPhone drives the business, but its sheer scale remains striking. The company generated $54.3 billion from iPhone sales during fiscal Q3 2026, the June quarter. That figure accounted for roughly half of its total $109.4 billion in revenue. Furthermore, iPhone sales climbed 22% from a year earlier. This outpaced the overall company, which grew 16%. So what has been pushing iPhone sales up this fast.
